name: InterContinental Nanjing
positioning: Hotel inside the nearly 450-meter Zifeng Tower on Gulou Square in central Nanjing, designed by SOM, with a sky-high steakhouse and a 78th-floor bar looking over Xuanwu Lake and Zijin Mountain, and Xuanwu Lake within walking distance
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside one of the city's landmark skyscrapers
Guests who like high-floor views of Xuanwu Lake and Zijin Mountain
City travelers who want to walk to Xuanwu Lake, Jiming Temple and Nanjing's universities

facts.text: The hotel occupies the Zifeng Tower, which soars nearly 450 meters high.
The tower was designed by the architectural firm SOM, led by Adrian Smith.
The tower's exterior has a triangular glass curtain wall that spirals upward like dragon scales.
The hotel is on Gulou Square in Nanjing's Gulou District.
The hotel is within walking distance of Gulou Park, Xuanwu Lake, Nanjing University, Southeast University and Jiming Temple.
Nearby attractions include the Ming Dynasty City Wall, 1912 Bar Street, Shiziqiao Food Street and Xinjiekou Commercial Street.
Xuanwu Lake park is an imperial garden whose culture dates back about 2,300 years.
Rooms have French windows and spa-like bathrooms with a separate shower and bathtub.
Some rooms and suites come with lake views and lounge access.
Guests can book treatments at Touch Spa.
78 Prime Seafood & Steakhouse is the highest dining venue in Jiangsu province.
Prime Bar on the 78th floor has a 360-degree view over Xuanwu Lake and Zijin Mountain.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 42 kilometers from Nanjing Lukou International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the hotel has a large business hotel atmosphere.
